gen-fs-bespoke-slab-mulish: Bespoke Slab brings a bookish, dignified serif with a high-set midline, while Mulish stays modern and approachable with strokes that never thicken or thin. Serif beside sans-serif, they feel like a lecture hall and its friendly hallway.
gen-fs-bespoke-slab-poppins: Dignified and bookish, Bespoke Slab sets a serious tone up top, then Poppins takes over with loose, rope-like curves and a tall, sturdy lowercase. Reading it feels smooth and steady.
gen-fs-bespoke-slab-rubik: A high-set midline gives Bespoke Slab its dignified, bookish bearing, and the serifs add weight to every line. But Rubik is the one built for reading, with soft sans-serif forms whose round letters stay clear when small.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-fs-amulya: Amulya is a contemporary, modern sans with generous gaps in its curves, easy going wherever the text gets dense. And Bespoke Stencil is the commanding, industrial voice, which would feel heavy-handed if used small.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-fs-plein: Bespoke Stencil is a plain, commanding display face with an industrial edge, set over Plein, a reliable sans with clear channels into its round letters. Its strength is the clean split in jobs.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans is contemporary and approachable, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems and strokes of identical weight, so it rewards a modest size. And Bespoke Stencil keeps its commanding, industrial presence for the heading.
gen-fs-bevellier-fs-technor: Sophisticated and graceful, Bevellier has a flat, stencil-cut look, tight sidebearings and a wide-looking lowercase with squat ascenders. Technor follows with cool geometric neon-tube lines, so a longer read feels light and steady.
gen-fs-bonny-cabin: Cabin looks like bent tubing, warm and clean, with open terminals. Bonny's literary serif adds a modest weight shift in each stroke, so the page gets a refined headline over a friendly, consistent text.
gen-fs-bonny-dm-sans: Refined type, friendly manners. Bonny does literary best, its curves lightening mildly toward the ends, while DM Sans does approachable best, with wide-set terminals on the s.
gen-fs-bonny-mulish: Bonny's gaping curves and mid-range stroke contrast give it a literary, refined look, and tight-set lines. Yet Mulish brings the pair's strongest quality, a modern, approachable sans with a large x-height and no thick-and-thin modulation.
